start.description: MET-13. Inclusive. MET-20 cuts it in the zone the entry declares.

end.description: MET-13. Exclusive, and carried rather than derived: a day across a daylight-saving transition is 23 or 25 hours, and a reader comparing this against its own clock knows whether the bucket is still accumulating without holding a calendar.

value.description: MET-13, MET-15. What the Worker accumulated over the period. Null means the Worker no longer holds this bucket and never means zero; a bucket it accumulated nothing in is absent from the answer instead.

dimensions.description: MET-19. The values this bucket is broken down by, present only on a read that asked for a breakdown with `by`. One entry per dimension named there, each a value from that dimension's declared set — MET-19 admits no other kind.

title: Metric bucket
description: MET-13. One period of one metric, whole under MET-12.
